body:
Shipped and installed:
1. PR #12 (3eade3e): BUG-86 — cargo-reap worktree branch resolution for git worktrees (.git file -> gitdir), detached HEAD fallback to origin/product/*, and --stale-days 0 check.
2. PR #13 (049fc6d): BUG-87 / ADR-88 — read-only XDG_RUNTIME_DIR sandbox compatibility (O_RDONLY flock fallback on pre-created lockfiles + TMPDIR sidecars for acq/wait + flock exit code 64..127 safety net), keep live builds >= 1h visible in cargo ps when --since is not passed, and deduplicate wrapper subshells in live_runs(). Also killed the 3 wedged sandboxed wrappers (2715408, 2896560, 3274221) that were stuck in QUEUED.
subject: Shipped BUG-86 (PR #12) and BUG-87 / ADR-88 (PR #13)
